Remark
[Numerical phase transition] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0334, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0335, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0336 ↗ def:chow-iv-lambda-neckpinch-data ↗ def:chow-iv-rotational-ricci-eigenvalues 1. ch36:36.11\group Numerical Simulation

Numerics show convergence to the round sphere for a subcritical parameter, neckpinching at the equator for a supercritical parameter, and a transition near $\lambda =0.1639$. At the transition the curvature concentrates at the poles while the geometry approaches a long thin javelin. After curvature normalization at a pole, the critical profiles are observed to approach the Bryant steady soliton. These are numerical observations, not existence theorems.
